name: Kʼakʼ Tiliw Chan Yopaat
contribution: The leader of the ancient Maya city-state of Quiriguá.
legacy: The most significant event of his reign—and of Quiriguá's history—occurred in AD 738, when his forces defeated the city of Copán.

checks.lead: Kʼakʼ Tiliw Chan Yopaat (previously known variously as Cauac Sky, Kawak Sky, Butsʼ Tiliw and Butzʼ Tiʼliw), was the leader of the ancient Maya city-state of Quiriguá.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
